required_body_for_soft_pull_grant.kind: soft_pull_consent — optional, defaults if omitted; typo is refused
required_body_for_soft_pull_grant.capture_method: typed | checkbox | signature — required, no default
required_body_for_soft_pull_grant.granted_name: required when capture_method is typed or signature; not required for checkbox
required_body_for_soft_pull_grant.consent_version: optional; empty uses current soft-pull-v1; unknown version is 400

never_read_from_body: consent_text — server copies words from src/consent/disclosures.mjs
granted_by — session staff or client id only
client_principal: may grant only for their own client_id
